Brand health03 / 03

Identify and mitigate brand risks, before the crisis.

A crisis almost always starts with a weak signal: a post, a rumour, a boycott call in a niche community. While it stays there, it is containable. We catch it early, assess how far it can spread, and warn you in time.

Book a meeting → See the questions ↓

  • 15-minute alerts, 20+ languages, with an escalation protocol.
  • The risk map of your sector.
  • A recommended response for each alert.
  • A review after each episode.

Presented by the consultant who ran the analysis.

What the conversation showed

Frequently asked questions

Who receives the alerts?

Whoever you decide, on the channel you decide, following the protocol agreed before launch.

How do you avoid false alarms?

An analyst qualifies every signal before alerting. Thresholds are editorial, not just volumes.

Do you support us during the crisis?

Yes: continuous reading, regular check-ins with your teams and a review at the end.
